caption: You don't have to pick which memories to delete. Most of the space is in how things are saved, not how many you have.

slides.title: Free up space *without* deleting your memories
Shrink the videos, keep the videos
slides.body: 4K video is the biggest thing on most iPhones. A smaller copy looks the same on your phone screen and takes a fraction of the room.

slides.title: Keep Live Photos as stills
slides.body: Same picture, without the hidden video clip saved next to it.
slides.tip: favorite the ones you want to stay Live

slides.title: Re-save your screenshots
slides.body: The ones you keep get saved again in a smaller format. They look the same.
